scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && npm run check:push-worker && npm run check:e2e && vite build
scripts.check:push-worker: tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --lib ES2022,DOM --strict --skipLibCheck push-worker/src/worker.ts push-worker/src/push-crypto.ts
scripts.check:e2e: tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --lib ES2022,DOM --strict --skipLibCheck playwright.config.ts e2e/mobile-restore.spec.ts
